name: pts-part-scanner-api
description: Headless, API-first Part Scanner backend for paidtosort (DRAFT 1, local WIP).

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to local-d1
scripts.check: npm run spec && npm run lint:spec && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run bundle:pages && npm run gitleaks
scripts.bundle:pages: esbuild src/pages.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --main-fields=module,main --minify --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="// GENERATED by npm run bundle:pages from apps/scanner/src. Do not edit; rebuild." --outfile=pages-bundle/scanner.mjs
